sections.title: NOW is the time to take control of diabetes.
sections.content_html:
There are 3 main types of diabetes. Type 1 diabetes involves autoimmune damage to the pancreas so the body cannot produce insulin. Type 2 diabetes is marked by insulin resistance. Gestational diabetes occurs during pregnancy.

All types of diabetes lead to elevated blood sugar levels. If not managed well, elevated blood sugar can damage your health over time—potentially leading to heart attack, stroke, kidney failure, nerve damage, or blindness.

If your pancreas is unable to produce insulin, you will still need some form of insulin. However, our approach differs because we focus on dietary and lifestyle changes that minimize your need for insulin.

conditions.name: Heart Disease
conditions.headline: Nearly half of all adults in the United States have at least one major risk factor for heart disease, like hypertension or high cholesterol.
conditions.summary: We offer holistic wellness plans that can reduce your risk of heart disease and heart disease complications.
conditions.articleBody:
At Be The Change Health & Wellness Center in Columbia, Maryland, board-certified family medicine specialist Sultana Afrooz, DO, and the team offer holistic wellness plans that can reduce your risk for heart disease and heart disease complications. To set up your consultation, call Be The Change Health & Wellness Center or request an appointment online today.

What is heart disease?

Heart disease is a term that encompasses the many conditions that can impact your heart’s functioning. Some forms are present from birth, while others develop over time due to your behaviors, habits, and genetic predispositions.
Heart attack, heart failure, and arrhythmia are all common forms of heart disease, which can cause troublesome symptoms like palpitations, chest pain, shortness of breath, and widespread swelling.
Your providers at Be The Change Health & Wellness Center can direct you to behavioral changes and wellness therapies that improve cardiovascular functioning as well as your overall health. Even if you don’t have heart disease, you can lower your risk by adopting a healthier lifestyle at any time.

sections.title: What is chronic fatigue?
sections.content:
Chronic fatigue, or chronic fatigue syndrome, is an issue that can affect your sleep, memory, concentration, productivity, and lots of other aspects of your life and wellness. Its primary symptom is extreme tiredness that doesn’t go away, even if you sleep more, take naps frequently, or rest throughout the day.
Beyond general lethargy, other symptoms of chronic fatigue include:
Memory and concentration problems
Frequent headaches
Musculoskeletal pain
Swollen lymph nodes
Insomnia
Your chronic fatigue symptoms can come and go or fluctuate. Factors like stress and past viral infections might contribute to chronic fatigue, but experts don’t fully understand the causes behind the condition.

sections.title: What is fibromyalgia?
sections.content:
Fibromyalgia is a condition that presents similarly to chronic fatigue syndrome. It’s a chronic condition causing musculoskeletal pain and fatigue in addition to other symptoms like:
Insomnia
Sleep that isn’t restful
Depression and anxiety
Trouble concentrating
Brain fog
Bladder or bowel issues
Experts don’t fully understand fibromyalgia, but they think it affects the way your nerves and brain interpret pain signals. Even stimuli that wouldn’t normally cause any pain can trigger your fibromyalgia symptoms. Women account for most cases of the condition, and the symptoms seem to affect women more severely than they do men.
If you have fibromyalgia, you might get pain that is concentrated in small regions called trigger points. Common areas for trigger points are the back of the head, shoulders, upper chest, and joints.

sections.title: About Frequency Specific Microcurrent™ (FSM)
sections.content:
The FSM machine emits vibrations at a frequency that affects certain tissues throughout your body. These vibrations stabilize the chemical structure of the tissues to make them more stable and less inflamed.
Within your cells, FSM increases adenosine triphosphate (ATP), a molecule that helps convert stored calories into energy. The increase in ATP production helps your body repair damaged cells. FSM also decreases inflammatory cytokines to reduce inflammation, which in turn reduces pain.
If FSM isn’t the right choice for you, your provider at Be The Change Health & Wellness Center might recommend a personalized wellness plan to ease your pain. Supplements, dietary changes, and exercise can all improve your wellness if you have long-lasting or severe pain.

sections.title: What should I expect during pain relief services?
sections.content:
It might feel a bit intimidating coming in for your first FSM pain relief treatment at Be The Change Health & Wellness Center. Knowing what to expect can ease some of your anxiety, and your provider can answer all of your questions about FSM before you start.
You should arrive for your appointment wearing comfortable clothing. Upon your arrival, you lie on an examination table as your provider places warm, damp towels over various parts of your body, depending on your reasons for needing pain relief services.
Your provider connects the towels to the FSM machine, which sends low-level currents to your body for 30-120 minutes. You don’t feel any discomfort or pain throughout the FSM procedure, but you might feel some warmth or the sensation of your tissues softening.

conditions.name: Hormone Imbalance
conditions.summary: Achieve hormonal balance through holistic therapies that support health in men and women of all ages.
conditions.articleBody:
Naturopathic and integrative medicine services at Be The Change Wellness Center can help you achieve and maintain hormonal balance by using holistic therapies to support hormonal health in both men and women at all stages of life.

Whether you're a woman transitioning through perimenopause and menopause or a man noticing the effects of hormonal changes with age, shifting hormones can disrupt all aspects of your well-being.

Declining hormones with age contribute to symptoms that can range from mood changes and insomnia to decreased libido or challenges with sexual health. Hormonal changes can even put you at an increased risk for some chronic illnesses, such as heart disease and osteoporosis.

integrativeApproach.title: Our Integrative Approach to Hormone Imbalance
integrativeApproach.body:
The conventional approach to hormone balance relies primarily on hormone replacement therapy.

Rather than prescribing synthetic hormones alone, we use bioidentical hormones along with other holistic therapies to support your body in achieving natural hormone balance.

conditions.name: Detoxification
conditions.summary: Detoxification is the process of removing toxins that can build up in your body and lead to pain, discomfort, and other ambiguous symptoms.
conditions.articleBody:
If you're experiencing unusual symptoms with no apparent cause, Be The Change Health & Wellness Center offers toxin testing and ion foot detoxification services.

Sometimes toxins come from within. Your body produces natural hormonal by-products that can also contribute to toxin buildup. Detoxification is the process of removing toxins that can build up in your body and lead to pain, discomfort, and other ambiguous symptoms.

We test for toxins and remove them through ion foot detoxing and nutrition plans—either as a stand-alone treatment or as part of a larger personal wellness plan.

conditions.name: Concussion
conditions.headline: The signs of a concussion can take some time to appear, and you’re at an especially high risk for serious complications if you get a second concussion before the first fully heals.
conditions.summary: We can treat brain injuries like concussions with hyperbaric oxygen therapy or Frequency Specific Microcurrent™ (FSM) therapy.
conditions.articleBody:
At Be The Change Health & Wellness Center in Columbia, Maryland, Sultana Afrooz, DO, and the team can treat brain injuries like concussions with hyperbaric oxygen therapy or Frequency Specific Microcurrent™ (FSM) therapy. Call the office or request an appointment online today.

What is a concussion?

A concussion is a mild type of traumatic brain injury that happens when your brain shakes rapidly back and forth inside your skull. If your brain hits the inside of your skull, it causes chemical changes to occur and can lead to brain cell damage. While concussions usually aren’t life-threatening, the lasting effects can be very serious.
If you have a concussion, you shouldn’t be quick to return to any sports or activities that could put you at risk for another. Concussions often happen during sports from impact or falls. If you get a second concussion before the first fully heals, severe brain swelling can happen, and the consequences could be deadly.
Be The Change Health & Wellness Center offers several therapies that promote healing throughout your body, including in the brain.

treatmentMethods.label: Hyperbaric oxygen therapy
treatmentMethods.description: Hyperbaric oxygen therapy has many benefits that could improve symptoms of a concussion, like boosting brain function and relieving inflammation. During the treatment, you lie down in a pressurized chamber as a high concentration of oxygen dissolves into your bloodstream. This improves tissue regeneration and repair.

sections.title: How can I tell if I have a concussion?
sections.content:
Concussions display symptoms that others around you might notice before you do. However, you might notice some symptoms yourself too. Soon after the injury, you might experience:
Dizziness
Confusion
Drowsiness
Headache
Nausea
Light sensitivity
Slurred or slow speech
Balance problems
Seizures
If the symptoms don’t arise immediately, they might appear in the days, weeks, or even months after the injury happened. As soon as you or a loved one notices symptoms that might indicate a concussion, you should seek medical care right away.
